title: Single guarded index: only blackboard.py writes blackboard.json
subject: single-guarded-index
ratio: Only blackboard.py writes blackboard.json, serialized by flock. No agent, in any role, in any session, may hand-edit the board or write it through any other tool; every board mutation goes through the guarded verbs (claim, update, handoff, add-task, reopen). An edit that bypasses the guarded index is a protocol violation regardless of intent or outcome.
dicta: Bootstrap-seeded at generation 0; no P-number exists for this invariant, so tier 2 is not honestly available (CD6) and the record takes tier 3 on distinct-identity verdict evidence: T-010 contention and crash-recovery smoke, verdicted done by harness-verifier (events.jsonl ts 2026-07-04T04:51:31Z), and T-000, which exercised the full guarded lifecycle. The reopen verb named in the ratio is governed by PR-001 (reopen-terminal-state); its recorded ledger gap remains open and owned by T-365 (CD3), and this record neither resolves nor cites that gap.
